home.hero_desc: We are facilitators of change, transforming realities through consulting, engineering, and education projects.
home.hero_bold: We work for the digital inclusion of vulnerable communities.
home.mission_subtitle: The Samval Foundation bridges high-level engineering with sustainable community development.
home.mission_card_desc: Democratize access to STEAM education through contextualized programs that strengthen local capacities and generate sustainable development opportunities in vulnerable territories.

home.values_card_desc: Each software developed funds robotics and programming programs in the Sierra Nevada.

about_page.hero_title:
More than a foundation,
<1>a technological bridge
about_page.hero_desc: We were born with the conviction that <1>Software Engineering</1> can be the engine of transformation for Colombia's most remote communities.
about_page.how_desc: We co-design challenges with local leaders that integrate regional languages, histories, and trades, prioritizing the local environment before introducing digital tools.

cards.culture_desc: We adapt technology to local languages and sociocultural contexts. Innovation should not erase identity; it must enhance it.
cards.measure_desc: Based on computational thinking from age 5, with tangible robotics to foster purpose-driven creation.
cards.support_desc: We train local teachers and facilitators to ensure technology remains and evolves within the community.

about_page.evolution_desc: Fundación SAMVAL - NIT: 901.036.033-0 | Entity dedicated to science, technology, and innovation in Barranquilla and vulnerable territories.

timeline.2024_desc: Founders' meeting in Switzerland (early) and official foundation of SAMVAL (July).
timeline.2025_desc: Visit to the Sierra Nevada. Launch of programming languages in indigenous languages.
timeline.2026_desc: Obtained Special Tax Regime (ESAL) for donor benefits.

about_page.cta_final_desc: We are ready to tell you how your company can be an ally of technology with a soul.

social_programs_page.title: Projects that <1>respect</1> the territory
social_programs_page.subtitle: We combine ancestral knowledge and cutting-edge technology for social transformation in Colombia.

projects.p1_desc: We manage visits from medical students from US universities on missions across the country. We provide preventive care and basic medicines to vulnerable communities.
projects.p2_desc: We bring technology to the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta. We use Thymio robots to teach programming while respecting culture and territory.
projects.p3_desc: We install servers with offline multimodal AI models that act as intelligent tutors in areas without internet access.
projects.p3_impact: AI at the service of the field

testimonials.t1_quote: Seeing our children program Thymio robots in the middle of the mountains is a dream. Technology doesn't take away who we are; it helps us show it.
testimonials.t2_quote: BiblioBurro's offline AI has allowed youth without internet to interact with global knowledge instantly.
